description: This file declares functions and types for parsing JSON schemas related to WiFi data models and registering them with a bus system. It includes function prototypes for parsing general schemas, WFA-specific schemas, and native WiFi data models, along with associated callback mechanisms.

methods.name: parse_json_schema_and_register
methods.description: Parses a JSON schema file and registers data model elements with the bus system, handling complex schema features and supporting both WFA and native WiFi schemas.

methods.name: parse_and_register_wfa_schema
methods.description: Parses and registers WFA Data Elements JSON schema under the specified namespace.

methods.name: parse_and_register_native_dml_schema
methods.description: Parses and registers native WiFi data model JSON schema, processing all root properties.
